blockers.tried: args type and op (manual does not name the argument)
blockers.workaround: arg is `kind`; wrong arg names silently return the full list with ok:true, cost 4 calls

blockers.wanted: a loudness target of -16 to -22 LUFS for a burst plus sparse bubbles
blockers.workaround: none; accepted -25.5 LUFS at -22 target. The miss grows as the target gets lower, contradicting the doc; the warning never clears and there is no pre-limiter peak readout

blockers.wanted: tell how long the sound lasts
blockers.tried: read 'silence start 0.000 s / end 0.290 s' and 'decay -60 dB never'
blockers.workaround: read the spectrogram instead; the labels are unclear (a sound starting at its peak reads as silent for 0.29 s; 'never' came from duration cutting a voices tail)

blockers.wanted: bubble loudness independent of radius (level goes as r^1.5 so large bubbles dominate and the limiter sets the level)
blockers.tried: narrowed the $rand radius range to 0.9-3.9 mm and lowered the mix gain
blockers.workaround: a normalizing gain per voice by hand would be needed; crest stayed 16-23 dB

blockers.wanted: a length macro on the wash alone
blockers.tried: mapped only the wash decay time; verify FAIL (decay measure flat at 0.06 s) because the burst sets the -20 dB point
blockers.workaround: also mapped the burst decay time into the same macro

wishlist: a splash/water impact node (burst + droplets + bubble layer) or a per-event level normalisation in voices
the pre-limiter peak and crest in summary so loudness misses can be diagnosed
a time-resolved centroid track in listen (only start/middle/end are given)
what_worked: poisson -> voices of a bubble with a $rand radius gave a bubbling tail in one go
macros with index/key mix gain and multi-node maps passed claims after one fix; verify's sweeps are informative
per-segment centroid and the band table confirmed the centroid falls 2.8k -> 1.1k Hz
